observation: Round-1 architecture critique caught a CRITICAL invisible to a green suite: the sole code deliverable (isolation harness) was placed in packages/design-system importing react-router-dom + @hyperidle/web, violating two committed @lore decisions (AG4 'no react-router import in design-system', AJ1-W3 'cross-package coupling avoided') and would have broken npm run check from DS (react-router-dom not a DS dep). Evaluator pointed at the existing packages/web precedent. One revise round 6.5->9.0. Third+ instance of producer/evaluator split catching boundary/contract errors (cf AK3, AJ1).

Spec drift behind a shipped reversal cost a continuous correction tax. AJ3's dependency AJ1 reverted Playwright golden-PNG visual regression to a vitest DOM-snapshot net, but the AJ3 spec text and carried-forward skill prose still referenced the golden-PNG world. Orchestrator had to inject ground-truth corrections so agents didn't build to the stale spec. Cross-WP signal: when a foundational WP reverses an approach, the reversal does not propagate into sibling specs or shared skill vocabulary, turning track-mate specs into landmines.

AJ1 design-source guard tripped the builder mid-green on trigger words ('golden baseline'/'pixel-for-pixel') copied into a /design SKILL.md screenshot note. Guard fired correctly; cost a fix cycle (reword + regenerate guard attestation). Self-inflicted: retired-approach (golden-PNG) vocabulary lingered in agent-authored prose. Same root as the spec-drift item — stale vocabulary from a reversed approach persists in new text.

Producer under-consulted committed @lore: the architecture plan violated AG4 + AJ1-W3, both committed @lore decisions; only the evaluator (critique) surfaced them. Pattern: the architecture/producer phase does not reliably grep existing @lore for the packages a plan touches; lore enforcement happens at critique. Candidate: a producer-side lore-check step in /architecture before handoff to /architecture-critique.

L-process WP cost profile diverges sharply from L-full-stack. AJ3 (L) was mostly skill markdown + a ~120-line code surface (packages/web/src/preview MockProviders + shared/design-review-decision helper); ran all 6 phases in ONE orchestrator session, no builder timeout, no green-phase split, zero snapshot re-bless, 8/8 ACs, 1 revise round. Complexity letter L conflates 'wide blast radius / cross-cutting process change' with 'large code volume'. Candidate sub-tag (L-process vs L-build) so planning forecast/scheduling doesn't over-provision process WPs.
